text_blocks.snippet: Common active scams targeting Central Illinois include fake DMV text messages, home repair fraud, and rental impersonations. Local authorities and the Better Business Bureau of Central Illinois urge residents to stay alert.
snippet_highlighted_words: fake DMV text messages, home repair fraud, and rental impersonations

list.snippet: Fake DMV/Toll Texts: Scammers send text messages claiming you owe unpaid traffic fines or delinquent tollway fees, threatening license suspension if you do not click a link to pay.
The Reality: The Illinois Secretary of State and local law enforcement do not send text messages demanding immediate payment or threatening license loss.
Garage Door and Contractor Fraud: Fraudsters set up fake online business listings, spoof branded apparel or vehicle signs, and pressure homeowners into overpriced or unneeded emergency repairs.
The Reality: Always independently verify a contractor's physical address, license, and official website before letting anyone start work or hand over money.
Rental and Moving Scams: Con artists copy real property photos to list fake rentals online, targeting college students with requests for deposits and upfront rent before a physical tour is allowed.

The Reality:
Scammers push for urgency and secrecy; always tour properties and verify ownership via county records before signing.
